**Finding: Compliant** — no redline needed.

The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant binding Northwind. I checked by searching for the standard triggers ("solicit", "hire", "employ", "induce", "recruit") and by reading the sections where such covenants usually sit (§ 12 Customer Responsibilities, § 16 Confidentiality, § 30 General).

Better still, § 12.3 affirmatively locks in our preferred position: it preserves Customer's freedom to hire "any person who responds to general recruitment" and has Vendor acknowledge that "Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment." That is stronger than the playbook fallback (mutual 12-month non-solicit with carve-outs), so there is nothing to negotiate here.

One adjacent item, noted but not flagged: § 12.4 restricts Vendor from developing or marketing a service competing with Customer's proprietary analytics products during the term. That covenant runs against the counterparty and benefits us, so it falls outside this rule.
